newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy can meet its 1997 CPI goal - Treasury.
newsitem.headline: Italy can meet its 1997 CPI goal - Treasury.

text.p: The government target for an average annual inflation rate of 2.5 percent in 1997 is "within reach", the Treasury said in a statement on Wednesday.
The Treasury added that the inflation rate might rise this month because of technical reasons.
Earlier national statistics office Istat said inflation in December was 2.6 percent year-on-year with average annual inflation in 1996 coming in at 3.9 percent.
Istat introduced a new basket of goods to weigh prices at the start of 1996 and this month will be the first time that the year-on-year rate will be compared to the current index.

"This could result in...an increase in the year-on-year rate," the Treasury statement said. "If this is the case it would be wrong to call it an increase in inflation, being purely a technical statistical phenomenon."
